mk.p1: A marketing designer working mainly in visuals and video, with six years in B2B tech. My work has always come down to one thing: turning complex material into something people can see and understand — installation manuals into tutorial videos and SOPs, hardware specs into application scenarios and space-planning proposals that sales and FAE teams can use right away.
